items.text: Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) ruled OUT vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again. Downgraded Saturday after Q listing.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmation; missed prior two games.
items.implication: Huntley start lowers Ravens offense ceiling; Zay Flowers value dips.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (and Dontayvion Wicks); Saquon Barkley QUESTIONABLE but expected to play MNF vs DAL.
items.why: Injury report; Saquon expected per reports.
items.implication: Goedert benefits; Saquon back in lineups if active.
items.opportunity: Goedert targets; Saquon full if plays

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) QUESTIONABLE; will test pregame after limited/majority practice Thursday then issues. McVay: lacked power/explosion.
items.why: Calf felt during practice; GTD late window.
items.implication: If OUT, Stafford targets funnel to TEs/WRs; nuclear days possible if plays with Adams out.

items.text: Mike Evans (Achilles/ribs) OUT confirmed by Shanahan; Deebo Samuel also OUT. 49ers WR corps decimated.
items.why: Coach confirm Achilles for Evans; hamstring Deebo.
items.implication: Kittle funnel + CMC slot upside; Kirk activated for debut.
items.opportunity: Kittle routes/targets spike; CMC more slot

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated from exempt, expected to play Sunday. Packers RB return.
items.why: Activated; facility access prior notes.
items.implication: Startable but backups poor quality per Levitan; monitor snaps.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) QUESTIONABLE after limited practices; crucial DFS slate status.
items.why: Returned limited Thu/Fri after multi-week absence.
items.implication: If active vs MIA, start; else Allen workhorse.

items.text: If Saquon active vs DAL, right back in lineups (agree Stephania). If Breece plays vs MIA, start him despite caution.
items.why: Return expected; matchup for Breece.
items.implication: Must-start if active.

items.text: If Puka Nacua can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell etc. TE lead.
items.why: McVay practice details; Adams already OUT.
items.implication: Higbee TE1 upside; avoid Stafford if no Puka.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec and 60+ yds both games. Love.
items.why: Caleb return juice; high TS/PPR.
items.implication: Start TE1/strong TE2.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring). Bijan full workload vs SF DvP that inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB catches high (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).
items.why: BRob hamstring OUT; SF soft vs RB receiving.
items.implication: Bijan RB1 lock with full carries + targets.

items.text: Kittle will go nuts (scheme + entire WR corps hurt); CMC tempted for more slot with Kaelon Black presence despite rare RB-WR statements.
items.why: Evans/Deebo OUT + others; CMC smile on slot question.
items.implication: Kittle TE1 elite; CMC receiving upside.
items.conflict: Rarely buy RB-as-WR but tempted here

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps last three weeks. Downgrade.
items.why: Snap share collapse.
items.implication: Sit/bench; role reduced.

items.text: Luther Burden 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet IR may cut 2/3-sets for more juice.
items.why: YPRR elite + TE injury opens sets.
items.implication: Breakout/flex upside with more routes.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving (workloads + soft matchups). Also AJ Brown (routes/TS), Tucker Kraft (DET TE D). Hate Rome Odunze, Josh Downs.
items.why: Usage + matchups (Lions soft TE/WR; RB Ds carved).
items.implication: Start loves; fade hates.
items.opportunity: Warren/Hubbard/Irving carries; AJB 97% routes/33% TS; Kraft TDs
